about: The Workbench icons of the InfraArcana drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/infraarcana.png) is upstream's icon/icon.ico at 128 x 128, under the game's own terms. InfraArcana-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, InfraArcana.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's InfraArcana.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for Controls, the manual and the licences; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
